content:
Playing taxi for Ava again. She's a good kid really. It's a hard age with responsibilities hitting faster than your motivation can keep up. 
Idk if I'm living up to my old mantra that a parent's job is to make kids that are better than them. She definitely isn't in some respects but definitely is in others. And she's her own person, it's not fair to hold her to my standards of success and she's too young to have figured out her own too. 
We are all just doing the best we can and hoping it's enough
